dspk from the command line: pipelines, devices, recordings, detection, sorting, benchmarks, streaming, model hub

```text
dspk [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`run`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/run/) | Run a pipeline spec (.json or .toml) over its inputs, or inputs given here |
| [`spec`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/spec/) | Check a pipeline spec, or print the spec's JSON Schema |
| [`doctor`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/doctor/) | What this build can do here: version, features, runtimes and their devices |
| [`autotune`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/autotune/) | Tune this machine's devices ahead of time, so first runs don't stop to benchmark |
| [`inspect`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/inspect/) | Launch geometries the selected runtime gives for a channels × samples buffer |
| [`open`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/open/) | Open a recording (any format dspk-io reads) and report its layout and read speed |
| [`probe`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/probe/) | Show a probe layout preset |
| [`detect`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/detect/) | Detect spikes in a whole recording and write them as a sorting (one unit per channel) |
| [`sort`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/sort/) | Spike-sort a recording (Kilosort4, EMUsort, MountainSort 5, SpyKING CIRCUS 2, Tridesclous 2) with the separate dspk-cli-sorter program (GPL-3.0; `dspk sorters install`) |
| [`sorters`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/sorters/) | The dspk-cli-sorter program `sort` runs: install it, or show which one is used |
| [`convert`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/convert/) | Convert a sorting between formats (Phy, .sorting.zarr, NWB units) |
| [`generate`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/generate/) | Write a synthetic recording (noise, line noise, drifting units) |
| [`benchmark`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/benchmark/) | Time processing on the selected runtime |
| [`serve`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/serve/) | Serve a recording over QUIC (signal and views) |
| [`receive`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/receive/) | Receive a served recording: throughput, latency, optional save |
| [`clients`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/clients/) | Who may connect to `serve`: enroll, revoke, list clients (certificates from the server's own authority) |
| [`remote`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/remote/) | Work with a `serve` server: info, files, sort on it, status, logs, stop |
| [`hub`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/cli/hub/) | Published model and sorter artifacts: list, info, pull, verify, remove, clean |

## Options of every command

- **`--runtime <RUNTIME>`**: env `DSPK_RUNTIME`  
  Compute runtime: wgpu, cpu, cuda or hip, among those compiled in (default: the first compiled in, GPUs first; `doctor` shows which work on this machine)
- **`-v, --verbose`**  
  Show debug logs (runtimes, transport)
- **`-h, --help`**  
  Print help
- **`-V, --version`**  
  Print version
